episode.logline: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
episode.continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Breathless):
events.text: "This ring..."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Urgent, Demanding):
events.text: "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Sincere):
events.text: "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Incredulous, Intense):
events.text: "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Earnest, Defending):
events.text: "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Revelatory):
events.text: "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Confused, Gentle):
events.text: "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Emotionally Strained, Weeping):
events.text: "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless):
events.text: "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging):
events.text: "My lost son wore that ring!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Pleading):
events.text: "Did your husband serve beside him?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Reverent):
events.text: "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate):
events.text: "What is your husband's name?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory):
events.text: "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Defiant):
events.text: "She needed help."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious):
events.text: "What are you hiding?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Firm):
events.text: "Nothing."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh):
events.text: "Show me your hand."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative):
events.text: "Girl. Show me what you are holding."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical):
events.text: "What is this?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Steady):
events.text: "Medicine."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending):
events.text: "Medicine? You are a new maid."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing):
events.text: "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute):
events.text: "No one."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant):
events.text: "Then you administered it without permission."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent):
events.text: "Because she was dying!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating):
events.text: "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce):
events.text: "The physicians were not saving her!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing):
events.text: "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening):
events.text: "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous):
events.text: "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding):
events.text: "It is an antidote."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative):
events.text: "An antidote to what?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Stern, Barked):
events.text: "Answer her."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute):
events.text: "Poison."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous):
events.text: "Poison."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Urgent):
events.text: "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror):
events.text: "You hear that?!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing):
events.text: "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged):
events.text: "That is not what I said!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy):
events.text: "Enough."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating):
events.text: "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive):
events.text: "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern):
events.text: "Take her."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
